description: This script is a test suite for 'git remote group handling', defining setup procedures, and various test cases to validate the behavior of git remote groups, including updating remote repositories, handling non-existent groups, and parallel fetches.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Writes the provided string to a file named 'mark' used for test synchronization.

methods.name: update_repo
methods.description: Updates a given repository by appending content to a file, adding it, and committing with the message from 'mark'.

methods.name: update_repos
methods.description: Updates two repositories named 'one' and 'two' simultaneously.

methods.name: repo_fetched
methods.description: Checks if the latest commit message in the repository matches the message in 'mark', indicating if the repo was fetched.

calls: git remote add -m main one one
git remote add -m main two two
